system.description:
You create a small sphere of compressed air in the palm of your hand before launching it at a target creature that you can see within range. You Fire two bullets of air. You can direct the bullets at the same target or different ones. Make two ranged ninjutsu attack, dealing 2d6 wind damage and Once per turn an affected creature gains 1 rank of Bleed.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, affected creatures must make a Strength saving throw, being pushed 10 feet backwards on a failed save. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, it gains the Swirl effect. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, increase the ranks of Bleed inflicted by +1.

Swirl. Creatures who would fail their saving throw, spreads all Elemental conditions currently affecting them around to all creatures, excluding the caster within 5 feet of them. Hostile creatures within 5 feet of the failing one gains 1 rank of all elemental conditions currently affecting it.
